senses.gloss: f. (שָׁכַךְ) appeasement, use of the root שָׁכַךְ.
units: <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 3:14">Esth. R. to I, 12</cite>; <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 2:1">II, 1</cite> (ref. to <he>כְּשֹׁךְ</he> <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 2:1">ib.</cite>) <he>ש׳ שאינה ש׳</he> it was an appeasement, and yet it was no appeasement, i.e. he was not reconciled without regret.—Pl. <he>שְׁכִיכוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Esther 7:10">VII, 10</cite>) <he>שתי ש׳ הללו למה</he> why these two appeasements?; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 1059:2">Yalk. Esth. 1059</cite> (not <he>שכיכת</he>).
